newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish Moeller opens NZ route.
newsitem.headline: Danish Moeller opens NZ route.

text.p: Danish shipping group A.P.Moeller's Maersk Line said on Thursday it planned to open a regular non-stop container vessel service between Singapore and New Zealand starting in February 1997.
In a statement, Moeller said the route would operate with two container ships twice a month on alternating weeks with a sailing time of 10 hours.

"The new service will link up with Maersk Line's global container network at Singapore, with special fast connections to northern Europe, the Mediterranean, the Middle East, Pakistan and southeast Asia," Moeller said.
Moeller's global container ship route network is operated in co-operation with U.S. shipping group Sea-Land.
